visualCharacteristics.structure: photo + name + role + appointed date + 'Learn more' arrow link, centered
visualCharacteristics.columns: 2 fixed-width cards per row (board), 3 per row for large sets (executive committee), 1 on mobile

contentPattern: Leadership profile cards. One row per person: cell 1 portrait photo, cell 2 name (heading), role ('Chair and Non Executive Director'), appointment note ('Appointed 1 September 2024.') and a link-only 'Learn more' paragraph to the bio page. Intro paragraphs are default content in an ocean-styled section.
